purpose: Compose typed installed operators, experiment against explicit outcomes, rank worst-case quality and retain workflows after independent confirmation.

properties.operation: catalog, plan, experiment or memory; default plan
properties.request: axm.workflow-experiment/v0.1: typed construction choices, measured goals, ranking objectives, stress scenarios and finite budgets
properties.path: new ordinary experiment directory; never overwrite existing artifacts or machine internals
properties.memory: optional separate caller-owned persistent directory for observations and confirmed workflow structures
properties.plan_sha256: optional expected plan identity; changes return HOLD_STALE_PLAN before writes

limitations: Only installed typed operators and explicit finite search, execution and validation scopes.
Fresh outcome checks are required; no silent canon or capability admission.
